summary: Generation Income Properties filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026 reporting, per its September 24 confirmation and a same-day press release/shareholder letter, that it fully redeemed the remaining preferred equity in subsidiary GIP VB SPE, LLC held by LC2-NNN Pref, LLC, an affiliate of Loci Capital Partners. The redemption payment and costs totaled $4,160,217 in the aggregate, funded principally with net proceeds from a September 21, 2026 warrant exercise transaction. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or public per-share terms were disclosed. Post-redemption, LC2 holds no preferred equity in the Company's subsidiaries. Watch deleveraging progress, balance-sheet liquidity, and any dilution from the warrant exercise funding source.
